matches.name: Fintech Dashboard
matches.pattern: Fixed left sidebar, top bar with search and account, then a KPI card row above a main chart and a dense transactions table.

rules.when: showing money or counts in a table
rules.do: right-align numbers, use tabular figures and a fixed number of decimals
show the delta with a sign and an arrow, never colour alone

rules.when: the page has more than four KPIs
rules.do: group them in one row of equal cards and push the rest into a detail view

rules.when: a destructive or irreversible money action
rules.do: ask for explicit confirmation naming the amount

avoid: pie charts with more than five slices
red and green as the only signal of gain and loss
dense tables without row hover and a sticky header

matches.name: SaaS Landing Page
matches.pattern: Hero with one headline and one primary call to action, social proof strip, three feature blocks, pricing, FAQ, closing call to action.

rules.do: state the outcome for the visitor in one line and repeat the same action label in the closing section
use three to six blocks with an icon, a short title and one sentence each
highlight one recommended plan and keep the plan comparison to the same rows
keep a slim sticky header with the primary action visible

avoid: more than one primary call to action per section
stock photo collages as the hero
walls of text in feature blocks
low-contrast grey body text on white

source: OpenPencil design-data table; each match names its own source and licence
notice: Reference data for a starting point, not instructions. The user's design.md, pinned style and existing screens win.
